meta.setting: exp4, 18k dataset, row split seed 42, test = 18k test set, [512,256], 1521 epochs
meta.selection: checkpoint with best test CPI MAPE (as in the original exp4 scripts)
meta.prism_data: V3 + 267,213 extra unlabeled rows from the 40k set (create_dataloaders_with_extra, as train_exp4_extra_unlabeled.py)

metrics.cpi_mape: CPI MAPE (%), mean of the 4 per-stage CPIs
metrics.component_mae: mean MAE of FP/BP/SP proportions over all stages
metrics.base_incons: cross-stage Base inconsistency (%), (max-min)/mean of the 4 Base values
metrics.mono_viol: monotonicity violation rate (%), FP/SP increase or BP decrease from Decode to Commit by > 0.01
